meta.name: add-gchat
meta.description: Add Google Chat channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成 Google Chat 消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要将应用消息发送到 Google Chat 频道。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Google Chat messaging into your application
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send app messages to a Google Chat channel.

howto.what: 为NanoClaw项目添加Google Chat频道支持：从channels分支复制适配器、注册模块、安装固定版本依赖并运行构建和集成测试；然后引导你在Google Cloud控制台配置凭据，把服务账号JSON存入.env。
howto.when: 当你要给NanoClaw接入Google Chat，或处于/setup流程中需要添加频道时触发。

say.note: 会自动复制适配器并注册、构建测试。

say.text: 帮我接入Google Chat，并配置凭据
say.note: 会执行代码改动，然后提示你去Google Cloud操作。

howto.what_en: Adds Google Chat support to NanoClaw by copying the adapter from the channels branch, registering it, installing a pinned dependency, and running build and integration test. Then guides manual Google Cloud credential setup and stores the service account JSON to .env.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Google Chat to NanoClaw, or during /setup when adding a channel. Also when you directly request the add-gchat skill.

say_en.text: Add Google Chat channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, and runs build and tests.

say_en.text: Integrate Google Chat and set up credentials
say_en.note: Applies code changes, then prompts you for Google Cloud setup.
Follows the documented steps to complete integration.
